tables.label: Double-Doubles
tables.qualification: At least one recorded. A double-double has 10+ in two of points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks; a triple-double has three.

tables.label: Triple-Doubles
tables.qualification: At least one recorded. A double-double has 10+ in two of points, rebounds, assists, steals and blocks; a triple-double has three.

tables.label: Points / Game
tables.qualification: Minimum 10 recorded appearance(s): 70% of the most games played by any team, rounded up.

tables.label: Field-Goal Percentage
tables.qualification: Minimum 10 appearance(s) and 130 attempts (10 × league team-game benchmark).

tables.label: Three-Point Percentage
tables.qualification: Minimum 10 appearance(s) and 65 attempts (5 × league team-game benchmark).

tables.label: Free-Throw Percentage
tables.qualification: Minimum 10 appearance(s) and 65 attempts (5 × league team-game benchmark).

tables.label: Effective FG%
tables.qualification: Minimum 10 appearance(s) and 130 field-goal attempts. (FGM + 0.5 × 3PM) / FGA.

tables.label: True Shooting%
tables.qualification: Minimum 10 appearance(s) and 130 field-goal attempts. PTS / [2 × (FGA + 0.44 × FTA)].

tables.label: Assist / Turnover Ratio
tables.qualification: Minimum 10 appearance(s), 39 assists and one turnover. Zero-turnover ratios are undefined.
